name: Monster hunt
objective: Kill the creature loose in the sector, or drive it off.
brief: Something alive is hunting ships here: a void leviathan, long as a cruiser, drawn by drive wakes. Kill it or drive it off before it takes another freighter.

objectives.text: Kill or drive off the leviathan
